import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static long n;
    static int k;
    static List<List<int[][]>> pref = new ArrayList<>();

    static int add_mod(int a, int b) {
        int res = a + b;
        if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
        return res;
    }

    static int sub_mod(int a, int b) {
        int res = a - b;
        if (res < 0) res += MOD;
        return res;
    }

    static int mul_mod(int a, int b) {
        return (int)((long)a * b % MOD);
    }

    static int[][] matrix_product(int[][] A, int[][] B) {
        int size = k + 1;
        int[][] C = new int[size][size];
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                for (int t = 0; t <= k; t++) {
                    C[i][t] = add_mod(C[i][t], mul_mod(A[i][j], B[j][t]));
                }
            }
        }
        return C;
    }

    static int[][] shift_matrix(int[][] mat) {
        int size = k + 1;
        int[][] res = new int[size][size];
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                int ni = i;
                if (ni < k) ni = (ni + k - 1) % k;
                int nj = j;
                if (nj < k) nj = (nj + k - 1) % k;
                res[i][j] = mat[ni][nj];
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void prepare_pref() {
        long temp = n;
        int digits = 0;
        while (temp > 0) {
            temp /= k;
            digits++;
        }
        pref.clear();
        List<int[][]> firstPref = new ArrayList<>();
        int[][] baseMatrix = new int[k + 1][k + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                baseMatrix[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < k; i++) {
            baseMatrix[i][i] = 1;
        }
        baseMatrix[0][k] = 1;
        baseMatrix[k][0] = MOD - 1;
        baseMatrix[k][k] = 2;
        firstPref.add(baseMatrix);
        pref.add(firstPref);

        for (int s = 0; s < digits; s++) {
            List<int[][]> currentPref = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int[][] mat : pref.get(s)) {
                currentPref.add(mat);
            }
            List<int[][]> newPref = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int[][] mat : currentPref) {
                newPref.add(mat);
            }
            for (int i = 1; i < k; i++) {
                int[][] shifted = shift_matrix(currentPref.get(0));
                currentPref.set(0, shifted);
                newPref.set(0, matrix_product(newPref.get(0), shifted));
            }
            pref.add(currentPref);
        }
    }

    static int[][] compute_matrix(long n_value) {
        int size = k + 1;
        if (n_value == 0) {
            int[][] c = new int[size][size];
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                    c[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                c[i][i] = 1;
            }
            return c;
        }
        long pw = 1;
        int d = 0;
        while (pw <= n_value / k) {
            pw *= k;
            d++;
        }
        List<int[][]> pref_d = pref.get(d);
        if (n_value == pw) {
            return pref_d.get(0);
        }
        long steps = n_value / pw;
        long rem = n_value - steps * pw;
        int[][] matrix_curr = new int[size][size];
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            matrix_curr[i][i] = 1;
        }
        int[][] coef = pref_d.get(0);
        for (int i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
            matrix_curr = matrix_product(matrix_curr, coef);
            coef = shift_matrix(coef);
        }
        int[][] remaining = compute_matrix(rem);
        for (int i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
            remaining = shift_matrix(remaining);
        }
        return matrix_product(matrix_curr, remaining);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        prepare_pref();
        int[][] answer = compute_matrix(n);
        System.out.println(answer[k][k]);
    }
}
